name: Article 24, § 3 – 350
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: 3. In the event of a transboundary disaster, the ERCC may facilitate information sharing among the countries concerned regarding the use of the Galileo Emergency Warning Satellite Service. The ERCC may disseminate public warning messages within a Member State only upon an express request from that Member State and following approval by its competent authorities of the content, geographical coverage and timing of each message. Responsibility for issuing, updating and withdrawing public warnings shall remain with the competent national authorities.
